title: FIFA Confirms Infantino, Diallo and Tashima as Presidential Candidates
detail: FIFA received three candidatures for the March 18, 2027 presidential election at the 77th Congress in Rabat: incumbent Gianni Infantino, France's Philippe Diallo (UEFA-backed) and Japan's Kozo Tashima. Former Tottenham defender Ramon Vega, who declared first, is not on the list. All three face electoral committee eligibility checks; Infantino's fourth-term bid is disputed by former governance chief Miguel Maduro. Diallo has said he will talk with Tashima about joining forces.
